title: VSift session.init-workspace data v1
description: The data member of a complete session.init-workspace result (P11, ADR 0021, maintainer decisions D1 and D2): the policy of an explicitly initialised worker workspace, immutable once created. durability durable is accepted only where OS-crash durability is qualified (publication os_crash_durable); a session of the workspace lives session_retention_seconds (default 604800, one hour to 2592000) and may be renewed within it. outcome is created, or already_initialized when the workspace existed with exactly this policy. It never names the workspace's path.
